summary: 3D physics oil-wrestling game inspired by Kırkpınar, built by Claude Sonnet 5.5 · Kırkpınar'dan esinlenen 3D fizikli yağlı güreş oyunu, Claude Sonnet 5.5 yaptı
key_features: Oiled grips slip: grip strength decays with hold time, oil and sweat, effort and stamina
Readable balance: a centre-of-mass lean over the feet decides steps and falls onto the back, side or front
Classic finishing moves as context moves: paça kazık, çaprast, künde, lift and carry, yere çal and a leg hook
Career through five weight classes to the golden belt, quick match and 2 players on one keyboard; touch and gamepad
The AI uses the same inputs as a player; the ?auto bot played a 26-bout career with 18 wins to the golden belt

social.headline: Grip, pull and throw on the oiled grass until your rival's back touches the ground · Yağlı çimende tut, çek, at: rakibin sırtını yere getir
